title: Sinkformers: Transformers with Doubly Stochastic Attention
tldr_zh: 用 Sinkhorn 双随机归一化替换 softmax attention，attention 可解释为 Wasserstein 梯度流，实验精度小幅提升
tldr_en: Replace softmax attention with Sinkhorn doubly stochastic normalization; attention becomes a Wasserstein gradient flow with modest accuracy gains
